title: Volcanoes of Mexico (hot and cold)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Mexico, one after another. You have three tries for each place and are told warmer or colder after a miss. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Michoacan-Guanajuato
rounds.fact: Michoacan-Guanajuato is a cinder cone; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1943. The data places it in Mexico.
